crossRefs.note: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in…
Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
who remembered us in our low estate; for his loving kindness endures forever;
For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those…
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…
Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. God will send out his loving kindness and…
My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience…
Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?
Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

translations.web: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
translations.bsb: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
translations.kjv: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger
translations.asv: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.
